long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The bowl is full again and I am empty, so I will eat before anything else.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I want to know how they do it.
The meadow has flowers I took before, and I will take another handful without asking.
The flowers I am carrying will go in the garden plot where I can watch them.
The morning sun is warm and I have earned a nap in it.
The plant is mine now, so the claim goes on record.
The seeds in the garden need a drawing so I can keep track of them.
I want to look over the island from the high ground before the day is out.

today.reason: I will eat, learn about seeds, take flowers to the garden, rest in the sun, and then draw and explore while the day is still mine.
